description: `--every 1h --program SLUG` fold into the suggested schedule spec (interval_seconds 3600, program_ref SLUG).

stderr.text:
OpenProse: INVOCATION_INVALID: Unknown option.
Detail: unknown option --every for `cli job create`; a schedule job's interval is interval_seconds (3600 = hourly, 86400 = daily), set in the --spec-file JSON object
Action: Create a schedule job from a JSON spec on standard input, previewing it first: `printf '%s\\n' '{"interval_seconds":3600,"program_ref":"demo","type":"schedule"}' | prose cli job create --spec-file - --preview`.
